body.name: \(I_T\)
body.space: Borel-measurable maps from \(\mathcal Z_T\) to \(\{[\ell,u]:(\ell,u)\in\mathbb R^2,\ \ell\le u\}\), equipped with the endpoint Borel structure
body.def: \(I_T:\mathcal Z_T\to\{[\ell,u]:(\ell,u)\in\mathbb R^2,\ \ell\le u\}\) is a single map fixed independently of \(P\) and evaluated only at \(O_{1:T}\)
